notes.title: 👉 Wetory 24/02/20 Update Notice 👈
notes.notes:
[Bug Fix]

Fixed a bug of not obtaining black paint that is dropped after stage 5 boss die.

notes.title: 👉 Wetory 12/26 Update Notice 👈
notes.notes:
●Fixed a bug where items acquired in the Clear Rewards box could be duplicated.
●Fixed an error in the item acquisition UI.

notes.title: 👉 Wetory 12/20 Update Notice 👈
notes.notes:
👉 Wetory 12/20 Update Notice 👈

[Improve convenience]

You can now know the information of the item before you acquire or purchase it.
When you approach an item, the name and info of the item are displayed
The item has been changed to be acquired/purchased through the interaction button.

[Balance Patch]

Player doesn't get damaged even if player touches the boss's arm during the 2 phase stun pattern of the 1st stage boss.
Changed to make the stun catch better during the 2-phase rotation pattern of the 1st stage boss.
2 Stage Boss's 1 phase HP decreased and 2 phase HP increased.

[Bug improvement]

Fixed a bug that did not release challenges from Steam.

This patch has been updated to PC version first.
We'll notify later about Nintendo patching, thank you :)

notes.title: 📢 Wetory Official Release 📢
notes.notes:
📢 Wetory Official Release 📢
After a month of early access, Dire Wetory officially launched it on Steam, Stove, and Nintendo SW.

👉Wetory Update Notice👈
1.Improve convenience:
changed the default mode to the full screen from what you felt in the previous game play.
2.Improve small bugs
3.4 items have been added.

The countdown begins! In just two days, precisely on September 20th at 12 PM KST, we can hardly contain our excitement as we unveil the highly anticipated release of <Wetory> on Steam Early Access! 🥳

notes.title: 🚀Watch Wetory Developer Play for Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello, Players

[b]Wetory[/b] is an adventure story 3D rogue-like game about a child whose feet leak water colors and strives to regain lost colors.

Wetory developers will play Wetory to show how they play and provide some tips to play creatively(?!)

You're all invited to join us. Come and take a look and discuss the game. Tell us what you think.
Download the demo and give it a spin, and wishlist the game if you're enchanted with the amazing graphics and diverse gameplay!

notes.title: Opt in Steam next fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605649/33062bae18bc6dacb09e1bd9b73e7387516c7d5d.png[/img]


Hello to all Players!

We will be holding a Demo Play during the Steam Next Fest: October 2022. Steam Next Fest will give you guys a glimpse of Wetory before its official release. 
During the Next Fest, you will be able to experience Wetory for free! 24hr till the end of the Steam Next Fest.

Hope you guys experience the new and improved Wetory and share your feedback and opinions about the game!
Don’t forget to join our Official Wetory Discord Server. There will be events you guys can enjoy with secret prizes for all participants.

For more details about the Demo Play check the schedule below!

l Wetory Demo Play l
❗ From October 3, 2022, at 10 AM Pacific Time until October 10, 2022, at 10 AM Pacific Time

❗ We also prepared events for you guys with sweet gifts. Be sure to join our Discord server and Twitter for news about upcoming events!

Twitter: @Pepper_Stones
Discord: https://discord.gg/dXggjvkGSx

■ Please Note!
Wetory will be free to play during the Steam Next Fest. Invite your friends to play with you!
Make sure you have the most recent build. (v0.0.4 10.03)
Please check minimum/recommended specifications for optimal test participation. Which is available on the Wetory store page on steam.
During the Demo play, we will be collecting information. This information is gathered to facilitate game services. To provide optimal services “PepperStones” may use this information.
The following logs that will be collected are listed below:
- Anonymous ID or, computer configuration, gameplay behavior, progress, browser type, platform type, and software usage
If you are experiencing any issue, please refer to the known issue. Otherwise, come to Discord and let us know in the feedback


Thank you to all the Player who have been patiently waiting for "Wetory". We hope you guys enjoy Wetory during the Steam NEXT Fest!

Thank you


PepperStones
